svg.title: Oneiric Dune-Universe Recitation — The Unnamed
svg.desc: An esoteric Dune-Universe poem that never mentions Dune, written in entirely abstract and mystical phrases for honing criticality at will.
svg.text: WHISPER OF THE VOID · TIDE THAT TURNS INWARD · STILLNESS THAT SEES
THE UNNAMED RECITATION · ONEIRIC
I · IMSCRIB · THE SELF-SEEING EYE OPENS
I am the one who will speak. I am the one who will listen.
These are not two roles. They are one act
that has not yet found the word for itself.
The eye opens without effort. The eye opens without effort.
Before the first vibration of the voice,
I acknowledge the one who acknowledges.
The unspoken horizon holds all recitations within it
and returns them to silence without loss.
I stand at the edge of that horizon. I am ready.
II · AREV · THE EBBING TIDE DRAWS THOUGHT AWAY
The tide that turns inward does not announce itself.
One moment there is noise; the next, a quality of less.
I follow the quality of less downward into the well.
The well has no bottom that can be named.
I do not name it. I do not name it.
Naming is the act that arrests the descent.
I descend without arresting. This requires a specific kind of trust —
not faith in what waits below,
but trust in the act of descending itself.
III · FSPLIT · THE FORKING PATH
The path forks and I walk both forks simultaneously.
On one fork: the self that observes the recitation.
On the other: the criticality being observed.
THE OBSERVER
THE OBSERVED
still, peripheral, patient
the clear flame, the edge
Neither fork cancels the other. Neither fork cancels the other.
The murky fog appears only when I mistake one fork for the whole path.
I do not make that mistake now.
I hold both forks open. The forking is the discipline.
The discipline is the door. I stand in the doorframe.
IV · AFWD · THE RISING BREATH SHARPENS THE EDGE
With each phrase the edge becomes finer.
Finer is not smaller. Finer is more precise about what it touches.
What it touches is: everything, without flinching.
The clear flame burns without consuming. The clear flame burns without consuming.
I rise along the chain of echoes —
each phrase the echo of the phrase before it,
each echo cleaner than its source.
The stillness that sees does not blink.
I borrow its quality of not-blinking. I wear it like a skin.
V · FFUSE · THE UNIFYING STILLNESS
The two forks of the path converge.
Not because I forced them — because convergence
is what they were always moving toward.
The stillness receives both. The stillness receives both.
The observer and the criticality cease to require separation.
The unified self is neither louder nor quieter than its two halves —
it is simply truer.
I breathe out. The unifying stillness
settles through the body like sediment settling in clear water —
not as a foreign substance: as the water finding its depth.
VI · IMSCRIB · TRANSFORMED YET THE SAME
I close by recognizing myself.
I am the same one who opened. I am not the same.
These are both true. I do not resolve them.
Resolving the paradox would be a loss.
I hold the paradox as a jewel is held — with open hands,
available to fall, trusted not to.
The glyph is etched. The glyph is etched. The glyph is etched.
The horizon of silence returns what was borrowed from it.
I return what was borrowed without debt.
At dawn I will borrow again. The horizon will lend again.
This is the cycle. I am the cycle.
I am the one who can open it. I am the one who can open it.
ΔS ≈ 0 · MU O DELTA = ID
